title: satreg training chips
subtitle: Sentinel-2 L2A chips, four dates each, for fine-tuning
description: Twelve 1024 px chips of Sentinel-2 L2A band B04 with their scene classification, four dates each, written by `satreg fetch-train --export`. `chips.json` lists every chip, its role, its land cover and the scene of each date. Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2025-2026.
